answer: An answer claiming a deep mechanism must supply at least 5 distinct supporting claims, and the count is checked before grading so shallow text cannot pass by padding. Because the forge count is verified against the summit text itself, the marble audit records each rejection and the operator cannot amortise one paragraph. Filling 190 aliases thus means producing 190 separate sets of claims, which is authoring work rather than a lookup. That is 23 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
